findings.evidence: BoundaryCondition.lean:118 `theorem exists_mem_withBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff` exists at order one; Higher.lean has only `ofContMDiffSection_mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff`.
findings.fix: Add `exists_mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff {s : Cₛ^(1 + k : ℕ)⟮…⟯} : (∃ w ∈ higherWithBoundaryIn A hp L k, toSection hp (A.halfSectionChartData.lowerOrdersL volume p 1 k w) = s) ↔ ∀ x ∉ borderedInterior M, s x ∈ L x`, proved from `ofContMDiffSection_mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff`, `mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff` and `toSection_lowerOrdersL_ofContMDiffSection`.
findings.issue: There is no higher-order version of `exists_mem_withBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff` (a `C^{1+k}` section is the representative of an element of `W^{1+k,p}_L` iff its boundary values lie in `L`), so the disc file has to repeat that argument.

findings.evidence: Disc.lean:65 `exists_mem_withBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff_of_unitClosedDisc (hp : 2 < p) (L : 𝕔𝔻 → Submodule ℝ (Fin n → ℂ)) {f} (hf : ContMDiff … 1 f)`; Higher/Disc.lean:45-48 private `constSection` and lines 66-73 inline proof via `mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff.1 hw _ h1` and `ofContMDiffSection_mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff`.
findings.fix: Add `exists_mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff_of_unitClosedDisc (hp) (L : 𝕔𝔻 → Submodule ℝ (Fin n → ℂ)) {f} (hf : ContMDiff closedUpperHalfPlaneModel 𝓘(ℝ, Fin n → ℂ) (1 + k) f) : (∃ w ∈ higherWithBoundaryIn A hp L k, toSection hp (lowerOrdersL … w) = f) ↔ ∀ ζ, ‖(ζ : ℂ)‖ = 1 → f ζ ∈ L ζ`, built on the general lemma above. Then derive the `e₁` and `i e₁` results (and, if wanted, the constant-section iff) from it with `contMDiff_const`, as `Disc.lean:84-103` does, and drop `constSection`.
findings.issue: `exists_mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_real_toSection_eq_const_iff` proves the boundary-value criterion inline, only for constant sections and `L = ℝⁿ`, using the private `constSection`. The order-one disc file instead states it for any `C¹` map and any `L` (`exists_mem_withBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff_of_unitClosedDisc`) and derives its examples from that.

summary: The core definition and its closedness and boundary-value lemmas sit at the right level, but the higher-order disc check reproves, for constant sections and `ℝⁿ` only, an argument that holds for any `C^{1+k}` section and any `L`. The general lemma it needs is missing from `Higher.lean`, although its order-one counterpart exists.
